# Media Provenance Registry

## Bundled backgrounds — 2026-10-08

The owner supplied these ten ChatGPT-generated PNGs and explicitly requested
that they be included in KANTA. No stock photography, third-party footage,
song media, logos, or music was sourced for this batch. Approval here records
that provenance and the owner-directed distribution decision; it does not claim
exclusive copyright or blanket legal clearance for generated content.

Exact original filenames, source, dimensions, SHA-256 hashes and repository paths
are recorded in `bundled-backgrounds.json`. App inclusion is authorized by the owner's instruction to add these
project-generated backgrounds. No third-party attribution requirement was
identified. The current batch preserves every source byte without modification.
